name: Portkey
short: Open-source AI gateway and control plane providing unified routing, logging, and observability with a free developer plan.

plans.name: Dev Plan (Free Forever)
plans.notes: 10,000 requests/logs per month ($0/mo, no credit card required). Generates a unified Portkey API key to route, log, fallback, and track 1,000+ models in your own local environment.

plans.name: Production / Pro
plans.notes: Higher request quotas, extended log analytics retention, enterprise guardrails, and automated cost optimization.
